7092895809582.description:
Ready to wear 4Pc formal dress
Feel like a queen in a dress that is pure magic. Style it with traditional jewelry for that royal vibe.

Choli:
Beautifully designed organza choli in the shades of plum features hand work on the front, back, and sleeves. Embellishments incorporate dabka and kundan work along its neckline, waistline, and sleeves hem. The back of choli features a finely cut keyhole finished with fancy tassels. To elevate the whole look, maroon velvet piping is added – finished with emerald green pearls at waist and sleeves.

Lehnga:
Artfully designed cascading lehnga made from our luxurious velvet with a touch of raw silk features an adjustable drawstring waist. Noteworthy details display fully composed embroidered panels with two colored detailed velvet patching. The handwork paisleys at each panel unveil a stunning fusion of emerald green and maroon colors. Striking material details withhold a blend of mukesh, resham, dabka, naqshi, pearls, crystals, and more. Finished with emerald green and maroon velvet borders, hand embroidered at hem.
